name: build-visionos-apps
description: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 apps with first-party Xcode and Apple Vision Pro workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 apps with first-party Xcode workflows
interface.longDescription: Development for Apple Vision Pro on visionOS 27: spatial SwiftUI and Chart3D, ARKit, SharePlay, WidgetKit, immersive media, app architecture, signing, packaging, SwiftPM, simulator UI automation, first-party Xcode build/run/debug workflows, command entrypoints, and Run-button bootstrap. Link to Build with RealityKit for RealityKit runtime implementation, Profile & Optimize RealityKit for performance evidence, and Build with Reality Composer Pro 3 for authored graph, package, and USD asset-pipeline work.
defaultPrompt: Build, run, and debug a visionOS 27 app with Xcode and Apple Vision Pro Simulator.
Choose the right window, volume, immersive surface, ARKit provider, SharePlay flow, or WidgetKit surface.
Route RealityKit implementation to Build with RealityKit, performance investigation to Profile & Optimize RealityKit, and authored RCP3 graph/package work to Build with Reality Composer Pro 3.
